newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's unit to buy Cellarmasters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's unit to buy Cellarmasters.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday its Mildara Blass unit planned to buy Cellarmasters Pty Ltd for a total outlay, including borrowings, of A$160 million.
Mildara said Cellermasters operates a mail and telephone order wine business and through its wine clubs in Australia and New Zealand is the world's second largest wine club operator.
"The return will significantly exceed the cost of capital and will be earnings per share positive from day one," Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel said in a statement.
"We have purchased wine earnings at a price below prevailing market multiples," Kunkel said.
Cellarmasters also owns 200 hectares of vineyard land in South Australia and has a modern winery and production facility in the Barossa Valley, Mildara said.

Mildara said Cellermaster had total turnover of A$154 million in the 1996/97 year of which wine operations accounted for A$104 million. Earnings before interest and tax is estimated at A$22 million in 1996/97.

Mildara chief executive Ray King said in the same statement that Cellarmaster would continue to operate independently. He said its activities complemented those of Mildara and that he anticipated significant potential synergies for both businesses.
At 2.30 p.m. (0430 GMT), Foster's shares were one cent lower at A$2.60.
